questions.question: What is the difference between overloading and overriding?
options: Overloading changes parameters; overriding keeps the same parameters in a child class
Overriding is about return type; overloading about void
explanations: Correct. Overloading: same name, different parameters (same class). Overriding: same name, same parameters (child class redefines a parent method).
The return type is not the key difference.

questions.question:
Which one would the compiler choose for procesar(5, 3.0)?
static void procesar(int a, double b)
static void procesar(double a, int b)
explanations: Correct. 5 is int (exact) and 3.0 is double (exact), which matches procesar(int, double).
For procesar(double, int), 5 would have to be promoted to double.
There is no ambiguity: procesar(int, double) is an exact match.
